description: This file defines a registry class and utility functions for managing chart state converters in a dashboard application, including registration, conversion, and checking for stateful charts.

classes.name: ChartStateConverterRegistry
classes.description: A registry class that manages chart-specific state converters, allowing registration, conversion, and removal of converters.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a state converter for a specific visualization type.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts chart-specific state to backend-compatible format using registered converter.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a converter is registered for a given visualization type.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a registered converter for a visualization type.
